description:
Demolition of
the existing structure and construction of a residential building rising from
one to two storeys in height to facilitate the provision of a detached dwelling
house (4-bedroom) (Use Class C3) including, outbuilding to be used as a garden
office, roof mounted PV (Photovoltaic Panels) panels, car parking port for two
vehicles, bin/bicycle storage and associated landscaping (Amended description).
